title: 第249章 双人合力破炉第250章 人狐一体天地洪炉
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
第249章：双人合力破炉！
炎狮皇子，玄蛇皇子大惊失色，
而玄龟皇子却丝毫不停，
法吞金身下一刻展开，
三十六条吞脉疯狂汲取法力，转身，裂云出鞘，一剑斩出！
“一斩山河缺！”
剑光如虹，直奔炉顶！
他要掀翻这顶盖，救出炉中四人！
从暴起到现在，皆在电光火石之间完成，一气呵成！
但皇子终究不是普通妖族，
尤其是玄蛇皇子，
只是在刹那间，便凭本能作出反应。
他猛地张口，
喷出一道漆黑如墨的玄蛇毒雾，同时身形一闪，竟然后发先至，挡在了炼妖炉前！
“玄龟！
你敢背叛太子殿下！”
陈默冷笑一声，
不再伪装。
周身妖气散去，露出了自己本来的面目。
“我不是玄龟。”

“我是来杀你们的人。”
话音未落！
一股毁天灭地的恐怖气息，骤然从他体内爆发！
嗡——！
十万丈八十一臂法相，
冲天而起！
遮天蔽日，笼罩整个广场！
八十一条长短不一的手臂同时舒展，八十一只漆黑眼瞳同时睁开，散发出令人心悸的威压！
原本庞大无比的炼妖炉，在这尊法相面前，渺小得如同玩具！
“十万丈法相！！”
玄蛇皇子和刚刚爬起来的暴熊皇子，同时瞳孔一缩，脸色惨白如纸！
这怎么可能？！
一个人类，怎么可能凝聚出十万丈的法相？！
而且还是这么一个怪异的、长着八十一条手臂的法相！
“死！”
陈默没有半句废话。
法相最粗壮的那条手臂，带着碾压一切的力量，狠狠朝着两人拍了下去！
空气被压缩成实质，发出刺耳的爆鸣声！
大地剧烈震颤，裂缝蔓延开来！
“不好！”

玄蛇皇子和暴熊皇子同时大喝，拼尽全力催动妖力！
content_en:
Chapter 249: Two people work together to break the furnace!
The Flame Lion Prince and the Black Snake Prince were shocked,
But Prince Xuangui didn’t stop at all.
The golden body of Fatun unfolded at the next moment,
Thirty-six swallowing veins crazily absorbed mana, turned around, split the clouds, unsheathed them, and slashed out with one sword!
"Cut the mountains and rivers with one strike!"
The sword light is like a rainbow, heading straight to the top of the furnace!
He wants to lift the lid and rescue the four people in the furnace!
From the explosion to the present, everything was completed in a blink of an eye, all in one go!
But the prince is not an ordinary demon clan after all.
Especially Prince Xuan She,
In just a split second, he reacted instinctively.
He opened his mouth suddenly,
He sprayed out a black snake poisonous mist as black as ink, and at the same time, he flashed his body and came first, blocking the demon refining furnace!
"Xuangui!
How dare you betray His Highness the Crown Prince! "
Chen Mo sneered,
No more pretense.
The demonic aura around him dissipated, revealing his true face.
"I'm not a black turtle."
"I'm here to kill you."
The words have not yet been spoken!
A terrifying aura that destroyed heaven and earth suddenly erupted from his body!
Buzz—!
One hundred thousand feet and eighty-one arms of Dharma,
Soaring into the sky!
Covering the sky and the sun, covering the entire square!
Eighty-one arms of different lengths stretched at the same time, and eighty-one dark eyes opened at the same time, exuding a heart-stopping pressure!
The originally huge demon refining furnace was as small as a toy in front of this Dharma Prime!
"One hundred thousand feet of Dharma!!"
The pupils of Prince Black Snake and Prince Tyrannosaurus who just got up shrank at the same time, and their faces were as pale as paper!
How is this possible? !
How is it possible for a human being to condense a dharma image that is hundreds of thousands of feet long? !
And it’s such a weird dharma image with eighty-one arms!
"Death!"
Chen Mo didn't say any nonsense.
The Dharma Prime's strongest arm, with overwhelming power, slapped the two of them hard!
The air was compressed into substance, making a harsh explosion!
The ground shook violently and cracks spread!
"Not good!"
The Black Snake Prince and the Violent Bear Prince shouted at the same time, trying their best to activate their demonic power!
